cases.name: Wendy Cooper
cases.about: She was a high school sophomore who loved keeping tropical fish, music, drawing, and sewing.
cases.narrative: He bludgeoned her to death with a rock after removing her clothing. In 9/1974, her naked badly decomposed body was discovered by a couple training their dog in a shale bank in the town of Plymouth, NY.
